title: Yoneda class of a pulled-back extension
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and let $0\to\mathcal A\to\mathcal E\to\mathcal C\to0$ be a short exact sequence of $\mathcal O_X$-modules, with Ext as in [def-sc-ext-sheaf], and Yoneda class $\delta\in\operatorname{Ext}^1_X(\mathcal C,\mathcal A)$. For every morphism $u:\mathcal C'\to\mathcal C$ of $\mathcal O_X$-modules, the Yoneda class of the pullback short exact sequence $u^*\mathcal E$ is $\delta\circ u\in\operatorname{Ext}^1_X(\mathcal C',\mathcal A)$, using the Yoneda functoriality of [lem-sc-p1-ext-yoneda-functoriality].
